SELECT 
  userel, 
  SUM(seshclicks) AS total_clicks, 
  SUM(seshviews) AS total_views, 
  AVG(engscore) AS avg_engagement_score, 
  (SUM(seshclicks) + SUM(seshviews) + AVG(engscore)) AS interaction_score 
FROM 
  sessions 
GROUP BY 
  userel 
ORDER BY 
  interaction_score DESC 
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
  s.userel AS user_id, 
  SUM(s.seshclicks) AS total_clicks, 
  SUM(s.seshviews) AS total_views, 
  AVG(s.engscore) AS avg_engagement_score, 
  (SUM(s.seshclicks) + SUM(s.seshviews) + AVG(s.engscore)) AS interaction_score 
FROM 
  sessions AS s 
GROUP BY 
  s.userel 
ORDER BY 
  interaction_score DESC 
LIMIT 10;
